subject: Table moved by noon
text: Hi. Quick update. The fair moved up. We start at nine now. Not ten. Please bring the green banner. Bring two folding chairs too. The sign-in table sits near the east doors. I will set up at eight. If you can, arrive by eight fifteen. Bring water. Bring tape. The morning group will meet briefly. Keep it quick. Lunch is still open. Do not forget the sign sheet. Text me if the bus is late. This change matters. The hall locks early. Check your clipboard. Bring extra pens. Bring coffee. Bring snacks. Label the boxes. Use bold marker. Put the schedule on the wall. Ask visitors to wait at the side. We have volunteers. Share duties kindly. Wear comfortable shoes. Phone volume low. No loud calls. Bring reusable cups. Keep the aisle clear. If rain starts, move inside. I know it is sudden. It cannot be helped. Thank you. Talk soon. We will manage. Good luck. Call me. Be safe.
